source_fit_rows.source_population: 3-year-old boy in Spain presenting with intense anal itching initially treated twice for presumed pinworm infection before confirmation of Dipylidium caninum infection (pediatric case report)
source_fit_rows.family_population: parent describing a 6-year-old daughter with nightly anal itching waking her from sleep for 1 week and perianal scratch marks
source_fit_rows.note: Both are young children evaluated in outpatient pediatrics for intense perianal helminth-related 'anal itching' (used verbatim), adapted from a 3-year-old preschool boy with Dipylidium caninum misdiagnosed as pinworm to a 6-year-old girl with nocturnal perianal itching.
